No watches used in today's approved posts.

stop_reason: Not enough usable items for a LISTICLE (recipe needs 8-10) in one buyer niche. The Tissot Seastar photo is a full-watch shot, but Seastar is a dive watch. Tissot Le Locle T932.207 is a women's model. Oris photos were checked: the 7810 4051 image is a full watch, and the 7762 4054 image is a black dial. No more items were added without a niche fit.
